62:1: Everything that is in the heavens and in the earth glorifies Allah, Who is the Possessor of sovereignty, the Holy, the Mighty, the Wise.
62:2: It is He who sent among the unlettered a messenger from themselves; he recites His verses to them, purifies them, teaches them the Book and wisdom, whereas before they were in manifest error.
62:3: And to others from among them who have not yet joined them. He is the Mighty, the Possessor of Wisdom.
62:4: That is the bounty of Allah; He gives it to whom He wills, and Allah is the Possessor of great bounty.
62:5: The example of those who were entrusted with the Torah and then did not carry it is like the example of a donkey carrying books. How evil is the example of the people who deny the verses of Allah. Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.
62:6: Say: 'O Jews! If you claim that you are the friends of Allah to the exclusion of other people, then wish for death if you are truthful.'
62:7: Yet they will never wish for it because of what their hands have put forth, and Allah is the Knower of the wrongdoers.
62:8: Say: "Indeed, the death from which you flee will surely meet you. Then you will be returned to the Knower of the unseen and the seen, and He will inform you of what you used to do."
62:9: O you who believe! When the call is made for prayer on Friday, hasten to the remembrance of Allah and leave off trade. That is better for you, if you know.
62:10: And when the prayer is performed, disperse upon the earth, seek from the bounty of Allah, and remember Allah much so that you may attain salvation.
62:11: When they see a trade or an amusement, they disperse toward it and leave you standing. Say: 'What is with Allah is better than amusement and trade. And Allah is the best of providers.'
